title: Ninja SLUSHi: Is the Viral Slushie Maker Worth It?
description: How the viral Ninja SLUSHi frozen drink maker actually works, how long it takes, what reviewers liked and the catches to know before you clear counter space.
h1: Ninja SLUSHi: is the viral slushie maker worth it?
intro: The SLUSHi was one of 2025’s biggest TikTok kitchen launches. Here’s how it works, how long it really takes, and who it’s for.

image.alt: Slush machines with different coloured drinks

cardText: How the viral frozen drink maker works, and whether it earns its counter space.

sections.html: There’s no ice involved. The SLUSHi chills the drink around a cooled cylinder while an auger keeps stirring, so it freezes gradually instead of being watered down. Presets cover slush, spiked slush, frappé, milkshake and frozen juice.

Ninja quotes as little as 15 minutes, but reviewers found that bigger batches, warmer starting liquid and certain ingredients can push it towards an hour. Once it’s ready, it can hold drinks at serving consistency for hours, which is why reviewers call it a party machine.

• Sugar matters: reviewers warn that drinks need enough sugar (or alcohol in frozen-cocktail mode) to slush properly; plain water just turns to ice.
  • Minimum batch size: you can’t make a single small glass.
  • It’s big: measure your counter and cupboards first.
  • Expect some trial and error with thickness settings.

Reviewers from CNN Underscored to Gulf News were positive for households that regularly make frozen drinks or host often. For the occasional slushie, a blender is cheaper and smaller. Find it in our kitchen gadget finder.
